title: Is Dust Really Just Dead Skin? 🤧 #Shorts
description:
Is dust really just dead skin? Nope, most of it comes from outside. Dirt rides in on your shoes and your pets' paws, and tiny particles float in with the outside air. One study found over 60% of house dust originates outdoors. Skin is in there too, along with fibers from your carpet and couch. The fix: take your shoes off at the door, put a good mat just inside it, and with the heat coming on, check your furnace filter. Sources: University of Arizona study (American Chemical Society, 2009), UGA Extension, UCSF Western States PEHSU.

Explained in 60, podcast edition. Is It Really?
